title: Generalisation of Bureau-Guillot systems with Painlevé transcendents in the coefficients
summary: We construct a generalisation of what we call Bureau-Guillot systems, i.e. systems of first order equations with coefficient functions being Painlevé transcendents. The same Painlevé equation is related to the system and it appears as regularising condition in the regularisation process. The systems considered are birationally equivalent to the Okamoto polynomial Hamiltonian systems with rational coefficients for Painlevé equations, hence they possess the Painlevé property.
